# Hamza Bhatti

I'm Hamza Bhatti, a Frontend Developer and Agentic AI Developer based in Karachi,
Pakistan. I'm a full-stack developer with a frontend-leaning background and hands-on
SEO expertise — technical, on-page, and content, not just the technical side. I build
fast, accessible web applications and integrate AI into them using the OpenAI Agents
SDK and RAG systems.

## Core Stack

- **Next.js** — App Router, server components, and static/SSR rendering
- **FastAPI** — Python backends and Agentic-AI services
- **PostgreSQL** — relational data modeling and persistence
- **TypeScript** — strongly-typed, maintainable application code
- **Tailwind CSS** — responsive, utility-first UI
